result.title: 30 is not the new 20 — here’s what you should do right now #TEDTalks
result.description: Clinical psychologist Meg Jay has a bold message for twentysomethings: Contrary to popular belief, your 20s are not a throwaway decade. In this provocative talk, Jay says that just because marriage, work and kids are happening later in life, doesn’t mean you can’t start planning now. She gives 3 pieces of advice for how twentysomethings can re-claim adulthood in the defining decade of their lives.

result.title: How to Give Feedback That Lands | Renee St Jacques | TED
result.description:
Most managers give feedback. Few give feedback that actually works. Drawing on her background in psychology and executive coaching, Renee St Jacques breaks down what so many well-intentioned leaders get wrong — and introduces a three-part framework to help teams rebuild trust and perform at their best. (Recorded at TEDxFiesole on May 4, 2025)

result.title: How Screens Stole Childhood — and How to Get It Back | Jonathan Haidt | TED
result.description:
Humans aren't just social — we're ultrasocial, wired like bees and ants for deep connection. So what happens when smartphones take over childhood, tablets replace textbooks and AI companies infiltrate our kids’ lives? Social psychologist Jonathan Haidt lays out three principles of technoskepticism — and explains why, two years after sounding the alarm in "The Anxious Generation," he's more concerned (and hopeful) than ever before. (Recorded at TED2026 on April 15, 2026)

result.title: The library isn’t just for books — it’s a gateway to your community
Sharing your truth may just help others find theirs. #TEDTalks
result.description: When fashion model Geena Rocero first saw a photo of herself in a bikini, "I thought ... you have arrived!" As she reveals, that's because she was born with the gender assignment "boy." In this moving talk, Rocero tells the story of becoming who she always knew she was.
